next.reason: 1985: 'the files referenced by file-name-2 and file-name-3 must not be in the open mode.'; 2023: 'otherwise the EC-SORT-MERGE-FILE-OPEN exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the MERGE statement terminates.'. 2023 sets an exception and terminates MERGE if an input file is open.
